message: Happy Christmas. The sprouts can wait one morning, and so can the watering. Come in, get warm and let someone else make the tea for once.
palette: cream paper ground, holly red, bottle green, terracotta, frosty sage, warm brown
typeface: condensed red display serif with a vintage seed-packet feel
art_direction: Vintage storybook gouache illustration of a frosty allotment at Christmas: a green watering can, terracotta pots, sprout stalks, seed packets and a red shed strung with fairy lights.
direction: Vintage allotment storybook illustration, warm and detailed, like a 1950s seed catalogue cover at Christmas.

message: Merry Christmas. May your numbers come up, your tea stay hot and nobody touch the last mince pie but you. Full house by teatime.
palette: deep cranberry red ground, cream, bingo-dabber red, holly green, paper-crown gold, black
art_direction: Flat graphic illustration on a deep cranberry ground: a cream bingo card dotted with red dabs, a gold paper crown, loose red counters, a black pen and sprigs of holly.
direction: Clean flat graphic poster illustration with a soft paper texture.

message: Happy Christmas. Here's to long walks, short legs and working out who did it before the last episode. Give Frank a sausage from me.
palette: royal blue night, snow white, post-box red, warm shop-window gold, chestnut brown
art_direction: Bright painterly illustration of a snowy high street at night: glowing shop windows, a lamp post, falling snow, a sausage dog in a red Christmas jumper on a lead, a phone playing a podcast.
direction: Bright painterly illustration with visible brushwork and a deep blue winter night.

message: Merry Christmas. The house was a bargain, the heating bill is not, and we're all very glad you bought it when you did.
palette: pale duck-egg blue ground, snow white, soft brick, Santa red, fir green, warm grey
typeface: refined book serif in charcoal with the odd word in italic
art_direction: Delicate watercolour and fine-line illustration: a snowy semi-detached house with lit windows, a garden gate, small fir trees, Santa with his sack reading a list.
direction: Quiet, delicate watercolour illustration with lots of pale space.

message: Happy Christmas. Thank you for every roastie, every timer and every speech about how little oil it uses. Same again this year please.
palette: cream ground, tomato red, black, roast gold, warm wood brown, fir green
typeface: heavy condensed grotesque in black with one line in red
art_direction: Bold retro screen-print style kitchen scene: a black air fryer with its basket of golden roast potatoes, fairy lights along the shelf, a red checked tea towel, Christmas crackers.
direction: Bold retro screen-print illustration with flat inks and a little grain.

message: Merry Christmas. Santa says Biscuit is the best looked-after guinea pig on his whole round. Extra carrots all round, and one for you.
palette: sky blue ground, Santa red, elf green, hutch wood brown, straw yellow, white
typeface: neat white handwritten print, like a child's best writing
art_direction: Soft children's picture-book illustration: a wooden guinea pig hutch with straw and fairy lights, a small wreath, a carrot, a reindeer peeking over, snow on the roof.
direction: Gentle children's picture-book illustration in soft gouache.

message: Happy Christmas. You're braver than the rest of us put together. We'll keep the kettle on and the oven warm until you're back and dry.
palette: bright sky blue, lake teal, snow white, bobble-hat cream, flask green, tartan red
art_direction: Bright painterly illustration of a frosty lakeside on Christmas morning: still blue water, snowy hills, a swim ladder, a steaming flask, a towel and a tartan blanket.
direction: Bright, fresh painterly illustration full of cold morning light.

message: Merry Christmas. You cooked, so you sit. The dishes are officially somebody else's problem until at least Boxing Day.
palette: tomato red ground, stainless steel grey, white, paper-crown pink, cracker gold
art_direction: Bold flat graphic illustration of a kitchen sink after Christmas dinner: a tower of plates and pans, a tall tap, pink paper crowns, gold crackers, a striped tea towel.
direction: Bold flat graphic illustration in a few strong colours.

message: Happy Christmas. Get the miles in while the roads are quiet, then come home to dinner. We'll save you a cracker and a seat by the fire.
palette: charcoal and deep navy, frost white, cycle-lane green, lamp-lit gold, cracker red
art_direction: Graphic poster illustration of a frosty street at dawn: a green cycle lane with a white bike symbol, frosted hedges, terraced houses, a glowing window with crackers on the table.
direction: Graphic poster illustration, dark and crisp with one bright green line.

message: Merry Christmas. One flat white, two teas, a hot chocolate and whatever Gran's having. You never get it wrong. Thank you.
palette: warm cream ground, navy, espresso brown, steel grey, berry red, fairy-light pastels
typeface: friendly rounded sans in dark brown
art_direction: Retro screen-print style illustration of a home coffee corner at Christmas: a steel espresso machine, a milk jug, an enamel mug, a mince pie, a string of coloured fairy lights.
direction: Retro screen-print illustration with flat inks on cream.

message: Happy Christmas. We know where you'll be by half past ten. Dinner's at two, so wipe your hands and bring the good screwdriver for the toys.
palette: pale putty grey ground, slate blue, pine wood, toolbox red, paper-chain brights, frost blue
typeface: bold rounded sans in slate blue
art_direction: Clean textured illustration of a tidy shed workbench at Christmas: labelled jars of screws, a red toolbox, a wood plane and shavings, a paper chain strung across, frost on the window.
direction: Clean, tidy textured illustration with soft grain.

message: Merry Christmas. Nothing in this street grows straight without you. Put your feet up today; the border will still be there tomorrow.
palette: soft cream, forest green, terracotta, berry red, frost white, brass gold
art_direction: Warm gouache illustration of a greenhouse potting bench in winter: terracotta pots, a young fir cutting, seed packets, twine, a brass watering can, a wreath on the glass, snow outside.
direction: Warm gouache illustration with soft winter light.

message: Happy Christmas. The chair's yours, the remote's yours, and nobody will wake you before the Boxing Day sandwiches. You've earned it.
palette: deep navy, armchair red, tartan green, lamp gold, cream
art_direction: Flat graphic illustration of a cosy living room on Christmas night: a red armchair with a tartan blanket, slippers, a mince pie on a side table, a fire in the grate, cards on the mantelpiece.
direction: Cosy flat graphic illustration in deep evening colours.

message: Merry Christmas. Thank you for the group chat, the seating plan and the six reminders. We'd all be eating toast without you.
palette: sky blue ground, post-box red, navy, warm wood, cream, holly green
art_direction: Cheerful flat illustration of a kitchen table mid-planning: a red rotary phone, a teapot in a knitted cosy, mince pies, place cards, a diary and a ticked list, crackers and holly.
direction: Cheerful flat illustration with a hand-printed feel.
